items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I don't want to stay in the band with him.

ctx.x: handed me a two-week notice. He handed me an envelope, and I was wondering what it was, and I opened it -- and I said, "Heck, you can keep Bob here." So I just packed up and went off. And old Braud says, "Oh, don't do that." And I remember Braud and Begidian(?) tried to talk me into...
Yeah. I says, "No, I don't want to stay in the band with him." And they said, "Why did they fire you on account of that..." I knew what it was right off, when the thing happened. But however...
